title: Giants' John Harbaugh and Matt Nagy will 'build the offense around' Jameis Winston

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants' John Harbaugh and Matt Nagy will 'build the offense around' Jameis Winston
sources.description: Following the serious knee injury to QB Jaxson Dart, Giants head coach John Harbaugh and offensive coordinator Matt Nagy are shifting gears to run the offense around Jameis Winston.
